records.literal_gloss: And I returned and lifted up my eyes and saw, and look, a scroll flying.

en.L: And again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and look, a flying scroll!
en.B: Again I looked up, and I saw a flying scroll.
en.R: I looked up again and saw a scroll flying through the air.

sw.L: Nikageuka tena, nikainua macho yangu, nikaona, na tazama, gombo likiruka!

pt.L: E outra vez levantei os meus olhos e vi, e eis que um rolo voando!
pt.B: Outra vez olhei para cima e vi um rolo voando.
pt.R: Olhei para cima de novo e vi um rolo voando pelo ar.

decisions.choice: the sixth vision: a flying scroll, the curse that removes thieves and perjurers from the land
decisions.reason: Zechariah sees a huge scroll flying, and the angel explains it as the curse that goes out over the land against those who steal and those who swear falsely (verses 3-4). The vision follows the cleansing of the high priest (chapter 3): now wrongdoing is purged from the land itself. The next vision (verses 5-11) carries wickedness away altogether.

decisions.choice: a scroll: a long sheet of leather or papyrus, written on and rolled up
decisions.reason: Books were written on scrolls (Jeremiah 36:2). This one is unrolled, so that it can be seen flying. Ezekiel saw a scroll written on front and back with lament and woe (Ezekiel 2:9-10).

decisions.choice: I returned and lifted up my eyes: I looked up again
decisions.reason: The verb "returned" is used with another verb to mean doing something again. On "lifted up my eyes", see 2:1.

decisions.choice: Again I looked up (B); I looked up again (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "looked up" for the idiom, as in 2:1, and Readable adds "through the air" to make the picture plain.

decisions.choice: Zechariah's account of his night visions (to 6:8): passé simple at L and B ("je levai", "il me dit", "je répondis"), passé composé at R ("j'ai levé", "il m'a dit"); imparfait for what was going on in the vision; the words spoken keep the tenses of speech
decisions.reason: First-person narrative in the prophets follows the narrative rule of the term sheet; this block of chapters starts in the middle of the visions.

decisions.choice: "un rouleau qui vole" at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet; "rouleau" keeps the picture of a written sheet rolled up.

decisions.choice: "otra vez alcé mis ojos y miré, y he aquí" (L); "De nuevo levanté la vista y vi" (B); "Volví a levantar la vista y vi" (R)
decisions.reason: The visions follow the Spanish prophets: L keeps "he aquí", B and R say what he saw. "Returned" with another verb (doing it again) is "otra vez" / "de nuevo" / "volví a".

decisions.choice: "un rollo que volaba"
decisions.reason: The scroll is "rollo", as in Jeremiah 36 and Luke 4:17 in Spanish; the vision's image is kept at every level.

decisions.choice: "gombo" (scroll) at every level; Readable "gombo la maandishi"
decisions.reason: "Gombo" is the word for a scroll in Luke 4:17 and Jeremiah 36. Readable adds "la maandishi" (with writing) so a new reader knows it is a written roll; the vision depends on its writing (5:3).

decisions.choice: Narration in the plain written style with "나" for Zechariah ("눈을 들어 보니", as 2:1); the angel speaks to him in 해라체 and he answers in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: As the term sheet's address forms for the angel and Zechariah (Lamentations-Malachi terms, Korean section 3), as recorded at 1:9 for the whole book.

decisions.choice: "cuộn sách bay" / "cuộn sách đang bay" for the flying scroll
decisions.reason: A scroll is rolled, not bound; "cuộn sách" is the published word for a scroll (Luke 4:17) and the term sheet's wording for this vision.

decisions.choice: um rolo voando (every level)
decisions.reason: The scroll (m2) is "rolo" at every level, the word Jeremiah 36:2 and Ezekiel 2:9 use in Portuguese; "voando" keeps the picture plain.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲנִ֤י רֹאֶה֙ מְגִלָּ֣ה עָפָ֔ה אָרְכָּהּ֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרָחְבָּ֖הּ עֶ֥שֶׂר בָּאַמָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, What [are] you seeing? And I said, I [am] seeing a scroll flying; its length twenty by the cubit, and its width ten by the cubit.

en.L: And he said to me, "What do you see?" And I said, "I see a scroll flying; its length [is] twenty by the cubit, and its width ten by the cubit."
en.B: He asked me, "What do you see?" I answered, "A flying scroll, {{units:about thirty feet|twenty cubits}} long and {{units:about fifteen feet|ten cubits}} wide."
en.R: He asked me, "What do you see?" I said, "I see a flying scroll. It is {{units:about thirty feet|twenty cubits}} long and {{units:about fifteen feet|ten cubits}} wide."

fr.L: Et il me dit : « Que vois-tu ? » Et je dis : « Je vois un rouleau qui vole ; sa longueur [est] de vingt à la coudée, et sa largeur de dix à la coudée. »
fr.B: Il me demanda : « Que vois-tu ? » Je répondis : « Un rouleau qui vole, long de {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} et large de {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}}. »
fr.R: Il m’a demandé : « Qu’est-ce que tu vois ? » J’ai répondu : « Je vois un rouleau qui vole. Il mesure {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}} de long et {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}} de large. »

es.L: Y me dijo: «¿Qué ves?». Y dije: «Veo un rollo que vuela; su largo [es] de veinte codos, y su ancho de diez codos».
es.B: Me preguntó: «¿Qué ves?». Le respondí: «Un rollo que vuela, de {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 4,5 metros|diez codos}} de ancho».
es.R: Me preguntó: «¿Qué ves?». Le dije: «Veo un rollo que vuela. Mide {{units:unos 9 metros|veinte codos}} de largo y {{units:unos 4,5 metros|diez codos}} de ancho».

vi.L: Rồi người nói với tôi: "Ông thấy gì?" Tôi nói: "Tôi thấy một cuộn sách đang bay; chiều dài nó hai mươi cu-đê, và chiều rộng nó mười cu-đê."
vi.B: Người hỏi tôi: "Ông thấy gì?" Tôi đáp: "Một cuộn sách đang bay, dài {{units:khoảng 9 m|hai mươi cu-đê}} và rộng {{units:khoảng 4,5 m|mười cu-đê}}."
vi.R: Người hỏi tôi: "Ông thấy gì?" Tôi nói: "Tôi thấy một cuộn sách đang bay. Nó dài {{units:khoảng 9 m|hai mươi cu-đê}} và rộng {{units:khoảng 4,5 m|mười cu-đê}}."

sw.L: Naye akaniambia, "Unaona nini?" Nami nikasema, "Ninaona gombo likiruka; urefu wake [ni] dhiraa ishirini, na upana wake dhiraa kumi."
sw.B: Akaniuliza, "Unaona nini?" Nikajibu, "Gombo linaloruka, urefu wake {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}} na upana wake {{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}}."
sw.R: Akaniuliza, "Unaona nini?" Nikasema, "Ninaona gombo linaloruka. Urefu wake ni {{units:karibu mita 9|dhiraa ishirini}}, na upana wake ni {{units:karibu mita 4.5|dhiraa kumi}}."

ko.L: 그가 나에게 말했다. "무엇이 보이느냐?" 내가 말했다. "날아가는 두루마리가 보입니다. 그 길이는 규빗으로 이십이고, 그 너비는 규빗으로 십입니다."
ko.B: 그가 나에게 물었다. "무엇이 보이느냐?" 내가 대답했다. "날아가는 두루마리가 보입니다. 길이가 {{units:약 9미터|이십 규빗}}, 너비가 {{units:약 4.5미터|십 규빗}}입니다."
ko.R: 그가 나에게 물었다. "무엇이 보이느냐?" 내가 말했다. "날아가는 두루마리가 보입니다. 길이는 {{units:약 9미터|이십 규빗}}이고, 너비는 {{units:약 4.5미터|십 규빗}}입니다."

pt.L: E ele me disse: "O que você vê?" E eu disse: "Vejo um rolo voando; o seu comprimento [é] de vinte côvados, e a sua largura de dez côvados."
pt.B: Ele me perguntou: "O que você está vendo?" Respondi: "Um rolo voando, com {{units:cerca de 9 metros|vinte côvados}} de comprimento e {{units:cerca de 4,5 metros|dez côvados}} de largura."
pt.R: Ele me perguntou: "O que você está vendo?" Eu disse: "Vejo um rolo voando. Ele tem {{units:cerca de 9 metros|vinte côvados}} de comprimento e {{units:cerca de 4,5 metros|dez côvados}} de largura."

decisions.choice: twenty cubits by ten: about thirty feet by fifteen, an enormous scroll
decisions.reason: A cubit was about 18 inches (see Genesis 6:15). No real scroll was so wide: this one is meant to be seen from far off by everyone. Its measurements are those of the porch in front of Solomon's temple (1 Kings 6:3), and some take the likeness to mean that the curse goes out from the LORD's presence. The angel does not explain the size.

decisions.choice: about thirty feet (twenty cubits); about fifteen feet (ten cubits)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the size in modern measures with the units setting, and the cubits as its alternative. Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: {{units:environ 9 mètres|vingt coudées}}, {{units:environ 4,50 mètres|dix coudées}}: metric by default, the cubit as the alternative
decisions.reason: French uses metric by default (style guide 7), on the ordinary cubit of about 45 cm as in the published French of Kings; the English gives feet.

decisions.choice: unos 9 metros (veinte codos); unos 4,5 metros (diez codos)
decisions.reason: The cubit is worked out at about 45 cm, as in the Spanish of 1 Kings 6:2; L keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: metric by default: "karibu mita 9" ("dhiraa ishirini"), "karibu mita 4.5" ("dhiraa kumi")
decisions.reason: The Swahili style guide uses metric measures with the original unit as the setting alternative, where the English converts to feet. The figures follow the common cubit of about 45 cm, as the published Swahili of Kings. Literal keeps "dhiraa" with no span.

decisions.choice: {{units:약 9미터|이십 규빗}} and {{units:약 4.5미터|십 규빗}}: metric by default, the cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: Korean converts to metric where the English converts to feet (style guide section 7; term sheet, Zechariah 5:2 on the standard cubit of 45 cm). Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: metric by default: "khoảng 9 m" ("hai mươi cu-đê"), "khoảng 4,5 m" ("mười cu-đê")
alternatives: US units as in the English
decisions.reason: Vietnamese readers measure in metres; the ordinary cubit is 45 cm, as published in 1 Kings 6. Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: the angel says "ông" to the prophet, and the prophet says "tôi"; where the Hebrew has only "he", the narrative calls the angel "người" at every level, as in chapters 1-4
alternatives: naming him "thiên sứ" at B and R
decisions.reason: The angels of Zechariah speak to the prophet with respectful "ông", as Gabriel does in Luke 1:13. "Người", with no span, follows the Hebrew and English "he" and keeps the narrative of all the night visions alike (2:2; 4:2); God is "Ngài" in this translation, so it is not read as a pronoun for God.

decisions.choice: cerca de 9 metros / vinte côvados; cerca de 4,5 metros / dez côvados
decisions.reason: The units setting has metric measures by default, where the English has feet, with the cubit (45 cm) as the alternative, as the Old Testament terms set it; Literal keeps the cubits.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י זֹ֚את הָֽאָלָ֔ה הַיּוֹצֵ֖את עַל־פְּנֵ֣י כָל־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י כָל־הַגֹּנֵ֗ב מִזֶּה֙ כָּמ֣וֹהָ נִקָּ֔ה וְכָל־הַנִּ֨שְׁבָּ֔ע מִזֶּ֖ה כָּמ֥וֹהָ נִקָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, This [is] the curse which [is] going out over [the] face of all the land; for every one stealing, from here according to it has been purged, and every one swearing, from here according to it has been purged.

en.L: And he said to me, "This [is] the curse that is going forth over the face of the whole land; for everyone who steals will be purged out from here according to it, and everyone who swears will be purged out from here according to it.
en.B: Then he said to me, "This is the curse that is going out over the whole land. As one side of it says, every thief will be swept away; and as the other side says, everyone who swears falsely will be swept away.
en.R: Then he said to me, "This is the curse that is going out over the whole land. One side of the scroll says that everyone who steals will be removed from the land. The other side says that everyone who swears falsely will be removed too.

fr.L: Et il me dit : « Ceci [est] la malédiction qui sort sur la face de tout le pays ; car tout voleur sera balayé d’ici selon elle, et tout homme qui jure sera balayé d’ici selon elle.
fr.B: Puis il me dit : « C’est la malédiction qui se répand sur tout le pays. D’après ce qui est écrit d’un côté, tout voleur sera chassé ; et d’après ce qui est écrit de l’autre, tout parjure sera chassé.
fr.R: Puis il m’a dit : « C’est la malédiction qui va se répandre sur tout le pays. D’un côté du rouleau, il est écrit que tous ceux qui volent seront chassés du pays. De l’autre côté, il est écrit que tous ceux qui font de faux serments seront chassés eux aussi.

es.L: Y me dijo: «Esta [es] la maldición que sale sobre la faz de toda la tierra; porque todo el que roba será quitado de aquí conforme a ella, y todo el que jura será quitado de aquí conforme a ella.
es.B: Entonces me dijo: «Esta es la maldición que sale sobre toda la tierra. Según lo que dice un lado del rollo, todo ladrón será barrido; y según lo que dice el otro lado, todo el que jura en falso será barrido.
es.R: Entonces me dijo: «Esta es la maldición que sale sobre toda la tierra. Un lado del rollo dice que todo el que roba será echado del país. El otro lado dice que también será echado todo el que jura en falso.

vi.L: Rồi người nói với tôi: "Đây [là] sự rủa sả đang ra trên khắp mặt cả xứ; vì mọi kẻ trộm cắp sẽ bị quét sạch khỏi đây theo như nó [ghi], và mọi kẻ thề sẽ bị quét sạch khỏi đây theo như nó [ghi].
vi.B: Rồi người nói với tôi: "Đây là sự rủa sả đang lan ra trên khắp xứ. Theo lời ghi ở một mặt, mọi kẻ trộm cắp sẽ bị quét sạch; và theo lời ghi ở mặt kia, mọi kẻ thề dối cũng sẽ bị quét sạch.
vi.R: Rồi người nói với tôi: "Đây là lời rủa sả đang lan ra khắp xứ. Một mặt của cuộn sách nói rằng ai trộm cắp sẽ bị loại khỏi xứ. Mặt kia nói rằng ai thề dối cũng sẽ bị loại khỏi xứ.

sw.L: Naye akaniambia, "Hii [ndiyo] laana inayotoka juu ya uso wa nchi yote; kwa maana kila mtu anayeiba ataondolewa kutoka hapa kulingana nayo, na kila mtu anayeapa ataondolewa kutoka hapa kulingana nayo.
sw.B: Kisha akaniambia, "Hii ndiyo laana inayotoka kwenda juu ya nchi yote. Kama upande mmoja wa gombo unavyosema, kila mwizi atafagiliwa mbali; na kama upande mwingine unavyosema, kila anayeapa kwa uongo atafagiliwa mbali.
sw.R: Kisha akaniambia, "Hii ndiyo laana inayokwenda juu ya nchi yote. Upande mmoja wa gombo unasema kwamba kila mtu anayeiba ataondolewa katika nchi. Upande mwingine unasema kwamba kila mtu anayeapa kwa uongo ataondolewa pia.

ko.L: 그가 나에게 말했다. "이것은 온 땅의 표면 위로 나가는 저주이다. 도둑질하는 자는 모두 그것대로 여기서 깨끗이 제거될 것이고, 맹세하는 자도 모두 그것대로 여기서 깨끗이 제거될 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러자 그가 나에게 말했다. "이것은 온 땅 위로 나가는 저주이다. 한쪽에 쓰인 대로 도둑은 모두 쓸려 나가고, 다른 쪽에 쓰인 대로 거짓으로 맹세하는 자도 모두 쓸려 나갈 것이다.
ko.R: 그러자 그가 나에게 말했다. "이것은 온 땅으로 퍼져 나가는 저주이다. 두루마리 한쪽에는 도둑질하는 사람은 누구나 이 땅에서 없어질 것이라고 쓰여 있다. 다른 쪽에는 거짓으로 맹세하는 사람도 누구나 없어질 것이라고 쓰여 있다.

pt.L: E ele me disse: "Esta [é] a maldição que sai sobre a face de toda a terra; pois todo aquele que furta será eliminado daqui conforme ela, e todo aquele que jura será eliminado daqui conforme ela.
pt.B: Então ele me disse: "Esta é a maldição que está saindo sobre toda a terra. Conforme diz um lado do rolo, todo ladrão será eliminado; e, conforme diz o outro lado, todo aquele que jura falsamente será eliminado.
pt.R: Então ele me disse: "Esta é a maldição que está saindo sobre toda a terra. Um lado do rolo diz que todos os que roubam vão ser expulsos da terra. O outro lado diz que todos os que juram falsamente também vão ser expulsos.

decisions.choice: the curse: the curse written into God's covenant against those who break it
decisions.reason: The word is used for the oath that binds people to the covenant and the curses that fall on those who break it (Deuteronomy 29:11, 13, 19-20). The scroll is that written curse, now set loose against wrongdoers.

decisions.choice: will be purged out: will be cleared away from the land
decisions.reason: The verb means to be cleaned out, emptied, or acquitted. In the form used here it often means "go unpunished" (Exodus 21:19; Jeremiah 25:29), and some read the verse as a complaint: until now every thief has gone unpunished. The translation reads it as the result of the curse: the land will be cleansed of thieves and perjurers, which fits verse 4.

decisions.choice: from here ... according to it: as written on one side of the scroll and on the other
alternatives: from this place, according to the curse
decisions.reason: The words "from this" can mean "from here", that is, from the land, or "on this side", as in Exodus 32:15, where the tablets were written "on this side and on that side". Read the second way, one side of the scroll condemns stealing and the other swearing falsely. Both readings keep the point: the curse removes such people.

decisions.choice: stealing and swearing falsely: two of the Ten Commandments
decisions.reason: "You shall not steal" and "You shall not misuse the name of the LORD" (Exodus 20:7, 15) stand for the whole law: one sin wrongs a neighbor, the other wrongs God. Verse 4 makes plain that the swearing meant is swearing falsely by the LORD's name (Leviticus 19:12).

decisions.choice: as one side ... as the other side says (B); One side of the scroll says (R); swears falsely (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable follow the reading of the two sides (m3) and say "swears falsely", which verse 4 makes plain. "Swept away" (B) and "removed from the land" (R) give the sense chosen in m2.

decisions.choice: "tout homme qui jure" (L), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Hebrew "everyone who swears"; French "tout homme qui" is read here as anyone, parallel to "tout voleur"; the English has no gender span.

decisions.choice: "tout parjure" (B) for everyone who swears falsely
decisions.reason: A plain French noun for a person who swears falsely, parallel to "voleur".

decisions.choice: "según lo que dice un lado ... el otro lado" (B); "Un lado del rollo dice" (R); "jura en falso" (B, R)
decisions.reason: B and R make the two sides of the scroll plain, as the meaning decision reads "from here ... according to it"; "swears" is the false oath of verse 4, "jurar en falso" as in Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "kulingana nayo" (according to it), agreeing with "laana"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "according to it" is feminine and points to the curse; Swahili lets the class 9 "nayo" agree with "laana" so Literal keeps the reference.

decisions.choice: "bị quét sạch" (L, B) / "bị loại khỏi xứ" (R) for "purged out"
decisions.reason: The sense is being cleared away from the land; "quét sạch" keeps the picture of a land swept clean, R says it plainly.

decisions.choice: a maldição (every level); será eliminado (L, B); vão ser expulsos da terra (R)
decisions.reason: "A maldição", as the Old Testament terms set it for the covenant curse (m1). The verb (m2) is taken as the result of the curse, as the English does: "eliminado", cleared out of the land, at Literal and Balanced, and "expulsos da terra" at Readable.

source.text: הוֹצֵאתִ֗יהָ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּבָ֨אָה֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הַגַּנָּ֔ב וְאֶל־בֵּ֛ית הַנִּשְׁבָּ֥ע בִּשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וְלָ֨נֶה֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ בֵּית֔וֹ וְכִלַּ֖תּוּ וְאֶת־עֵצָ֥יו וְאֶת־אֲבָנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: I have sent it out, declaration of Yahweh of hosts, and it will enter into [the] house of the thief and into [the] house of the one swearing by my name to falsehood, and it will lodge in [the] midst of his house and finish it, and its timbers and its stones.

en.L: I have sent it out, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, and it will come into the house of the thief and into the house of the one who swears by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name falsely; and it will lodge in the midst of {{gender:their|his}} house and consume it, both its timber and its stones."
en.B: I have sent it out, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, and it will go into the thief's house and the house of anyone who swears falsely by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. It will stay inside that house and destroy it, timber and stones alike."
en.R: I am sending this curse out, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. It will go into the house of anyone who steals and the house of anyone who swears falsely by {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name. It will stay in that house until it destroys it completely, both the wood and the stones."

fr.L: Je l’ai fait sortir, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et elle entrera dans la maison du voleur et dans la maison de celui qui jure par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom pour le mensonge ; et elle logera au milieu de sa maison et la consumera, et son bois et ses pierres. »
fr.B: Je l’ai envoyée, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et elle entrera dans la maison du voleur et dans la maison de celui qui jure faussement par {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. Elle restera dans cette maison et la détruira, bois et pierres. »
fr.R: J’envoie cette malédiction, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Elle entrera dans la maison de celui qui vole et dans la maison de celui qui fait un faux serment en utilisant {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom. Elle restera dans sa maison jusqu’à ce qu’elle l’ait complètement détruite, le bois comme les pierres. »

es.L: Yo la he hecho salir, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, y entrará en la casa del ladrón y en la casa del que jura falsamente por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre; y se alojará en medio de su casa y la consumirá, tanto sus maderas como sus piedras».
es.B: La he hecho salir, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, y entrará en la casa del ladrón y en la casa de cualquiera que jure en falso por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. Se quedará dentro de esa casa y la destruirá, con sus maderas y sus piedras».
es.R: Estoy enviando esta maldición, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Entrará en la casa de todo el que roba y en la casa de todo el que jura en falso por {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre. Se quedará en esa casa hasta destruirla por completo, la madera y las piedras».

vi.L: Ta đã sai nó ra, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, và nó sẽ vào nhà kẻ trộm và vào nhà kẻ lấy danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà thề dối; nó sẽ ở lại giữa nhà người ấy và tiêu hủy nhà ấy, cả gỗ lẫn đá của nó."
vi.B: Ta đã sai nó ra, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy; nó sẽ vào nhà kẻ trộm và nhà của bất cứ ai lấy danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà thề dối. Nó sẽ ở lại trong nhà ấy và hủy diệt nhà ấy, cả gỗ lẫn đá."
vi.R: Ta đang sai lời rủa sả này ra, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. Nó sẽ vào nhà của bất cứ ai trộm cắp và nhà của bất cứ ai lấy danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà thề dối. Nó sẽ ở lại trong nhà ấy cho đến khi phá hủy hoàn toàn, cả gỗ lẫn đá."

sw.L: Nimeituma itoke, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, nayo itaingia katika nyumba ya mwizi na katika nyumba ya yule anayeapa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kwa uongo; nayo itakaa katikati ya nyumba yake na kuiteketeza, pamoja na mbao zake na mawe yake."
sw.B: Nimeituma, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, nayo itaingia katika nyumba ya mwizi na katika nyumba ya kila mtu anayeapa kwa uongo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Itakaa ndani ya nyumba hiyo na kuiangamiza, mbao zake pamoja na mawe yake."
sw.R: Ninaituma laana hii, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Itaingia katika nyumba ya kila mtu anayeiba na katika nyumba ya kila mtu anayeapa kwa uongo kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}. Itakaa ndani ya nyumba hiyo mpaka iiangamize kabisa, mbao na mawe yake pia."

ko.L: 내가 그것을 내보냈다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그것이 도둑의 집과 내 이름으로 거짓되게 맹세하는 자의 집에 들어가, 그 자의 집 한가운데 머물며 그 집을, 그 나무와 돌까지 다 없앨 것이다."
ko.B: 내가 그 저주를 내보냈다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그것이 도둑의 집과 내 이름으로 거짓 맹세하는 자의 집에 들어가, 그 집 안에 머물면서 나무와 돌까지 모조리 무너뜨릴 것이다."
ko.R: 내가 이 저주를 보낸다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그 저주는 도둑질하는 사람의 집과 내 이름으로 거짓 맹세하는 사람의 집에 들어갈 것이다. 그리고 그 집에 머물러 있다가, 나무와 돌까지 그 집을 완전히 무너뜨릴 것이다."

pt.L: Eu a fiz sair, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, e ela entrará na casa do ladrão e na casa daquele que jura falsamente pelo {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome; e ela pousará no meio da casa dele e a consumirá, tanto as suas madeiras como as suas pedras."
pt.B: Eu a enviei, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, e ela entrará na casa do ladrão e na casa de todo aquele que jura falsamente pelo {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome. Ela ficará dentro daquela casa e a destruirá, com madeiras e pedras."
pt.R: Estou enviando esta maldição, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. Ela vai entrar na casa de quem rouba e na casa de quem jura falsamente pelo {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome. Ela vai ficar naquela casa até destruí-la por completo, tanto a madeira como as pedras."

decisions.choice: I have sent it out: the curse is already on its way
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form for a completed act: the LORD has released the curse, and it is flying (verse 1). It can also be read as a firm promise of what he will do.

decisions.choice: it will lodge in the house and consume it, timber and stones: like a plague that destroys a house
decisions.reason: The verb "lodge" means to stay overnight. The curse settles in the house and does not leave until nothing is left. The law about a house with a spreading growth in its walls ordered it torn down, "its stones, its timber and all the plaster" (Leviticus 14:45). The wrongdoer's house, built with stolen goods or false oaths, will not stand.

decisions.choice: swears by my name falsely: uses the LORD's name to make a lie seem true
decisions.reason: An oath in the LORD's name called on him as witness. To swear falsely by it was to make God a party to a lie (Leviticus 19:12; Jeremiah 7:9). The thief wrongs a neighbor; the false swearer wrongs both a neighbor and God.

decisions.choice: their / his (L); anyone who (B, R)
decisions.reason: The thief and the false swearer may be any man or woman, so Literal gives "his house" the gender setting, and Balanced and Readable say "anyone who" and "that house". Readable says "this curse" for "it", and "until it destroys it completely" for "consume". The closing quotation mark ends the angel's words begun in verse 3.

decisions.choice: "celui qui ... sa maison" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Where the English has {{gender:their|his}}, French "celui qui" and "sa" are already generic, as the style guide says; no span is added.

decisions.choice: "déclare le SEIGNEUR des armées" (L, B), "dit le SEIGNEUR des armées" (R)
decisions.reason: The prophetic formula as the term sheet and published Isaiah; "le SEIGNEUR des armées" at every level, where the English Balanced and Readable say "of Armies".

decisions.choice: "declara" (L), "afirma" (B), "dice" (R) el SEÑOR de los ejércitos (L) / de los Ejércitos (B, R)
decisions.reason: Ne'um YHWH and "the LORD of hosts" follow the Spanish prophets at each level, after a comma, through Zechariah and Malachi.

decisions.choice: "su casa"
decisions.reason: Spanish "su" covers both readings of the English gender setting, so no gender span is needed.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy" (L, B) / "... phán" (R) for "declares the LORD of hosts", with the span on CHÚA only
decisions.reason: The term sheet's book-wide form for the Twelve: "Vạn Quân" as in the published Kings and Psalms, "phán vậy" kept for ne'um, as in Isaiah and Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "người ấy" (L) and "bất cứ ai" (B, R) already cover both men and women
alternatives: a gender span as in the English L
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "người" is not marked for gender, so there is only one wording.

decisions.choice: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다" (L); "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" (B); "하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" (R), each as its own sentence
decisions.reason: The term sheets' wording for "declares the LORD of hosts", recorded once for all of Zechariah and for Malachi. In God's own words the R title is "거느린", without -시-; when people speak about him it is "거느리신".

decisions.choice: "그 자의" (L), "자" and "사람" with no gender span; no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Korean "자" and "사람" cover men and women, so the English gender span has nothing to change; Korean has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide section 7).

decisions.choice: "asema BWANA wa majeshi" (L, B); "anasema BWANA wa majeshi" (R); "BWANA wa majeshi" at every level
decisions.reason: The prophetic formula as in the published Isaiah, Jeremiah, Haggai and the term sheet; Swahili needs no different word for the English Balanced "of Armies". Recorded once for Zechariah.

decisions.choice: "nyumba yake", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Yake" covers a man or a woman, so the English gender setting has nothing to change in Swahili (Swahili style guide 7). Recorded once for this block.

decisions.choice: a casa dele (L); todo aquele que, quem (B, R); no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal puts "his house" under the gender setting (r-en-1). Portuguese "aquele que", "todo aquele que" and "quem" already mean anyone, and the "dele" that refers back to them is ordinary generic Portuguese (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 7), so no level has a span. "Pousar" at Literal keeps the picture of staying the night (m2).

source.text: וַיֵּצֵ֕א הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י שָׂ֣א נָ֤א עֵינֶ֨יךָ֙ וּרְאֵ֔ה מָ֖ה הַיּוֹצֵ֥את הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And went out the angel who talks with me and said to me, Lift up now your eyes and see what [is] this going out.

en.L: And the angel who talked with me went out and said to me, "Lift up your eyes, please, and see what this [is] that is going out."
en.B: Then the angel who talked with me stepped forward and told me, "Look up and see what this is that is coming out."
en.R: Then the angel who talked with me came forward. He said, "Look up and see what is coming out."

fr.L: Et l’ange qui parlait avec moi sortit et me dit : « Lève les yeux, je te prie, et vois ce qu’est cette [chose] qui sort. »
fr.B: Alors l’ange qui parlait avec moi s’avança et me dit : « Lève les yeux et regarde ce qui sort là. »
fr.R: Alors l’ange qui parlait avec moi s’est avancé. Il m’a dit : « Lève les yeux et regarde ce qui sort. »

es.L: Y salió el ángel que hablaba conmigo y me dijo: «Alza ahora tus ojos y mira qué es esto que sale».
es.B: Entonces el ángel que hablaba conmigo se adelantó y me dijo: «Levanta la vista y mira qué es esto que sale».
es.R: Entonces el ángel que hablaba conmigo se adelantó y me dijo: «Levanta la vista y mira lo que está saliendo».

vi.L: Rồi thiên sứ đang nói với tôi đi ra và nói với tôi: "Xin hãy ngước mắt lên và xem vật đang đi ra này là gì."
vi.B: Bấy giờ thiên sứ đang nói với tôi bước tới và bảo tôi: "Hãy nhìn lên và xem vật đang đi ra kia là gì."
vi.R: Rồi thiên sứ đang nói với tôi bước tới. Người nói: "Hãy nhìn lên xem cái gì đang đi ra."

sw.L: Na malaika aliyezungumza nami akatoka, akaniambia, "Inua macho yako tafadhali, uone ni nini hiki kinachotoka."
sw.B: Kisha malaika aliyezungumza nami akasogea mbele, akaniambia, "Tazama juu uone ni nini hiki kinachotoka."
sw.R: Kisha malaika aliyezungumza nami akaja mbele. Akasema, "Tazama juu uone kitu kinachotoka."

ko.L: 나와 말하던 천사가 나가서 나에게 말했다. "자, 네 눈을 들어 이 나가는 것이 무엇인지 보아라."
ko.B: 그때 나와 말하던 천사가 앞으로 나와서 나에게 말했다. "눈을 들어, 나오고 있는 이것이 무엇인지 보아라."
ko.R: 그때 나와 말하던 천사가 앞으로 나왔다. 그가 말했다. "고개를 들어, 무엇이 나오고 있는지 보아라."

pt.L: E o anjo que falava comigo saiu e me disse: "Levante os seus olhos, por favor, e veja o que é isto que está saindo."
pt.B: Então o anjo que falava comigo se adiantou e me disse: "Olhe para cima e veja o que é isto que está saindo."
pt.R: Então o anjo que falava comigo se aproximou. Ele disse: "Olhe para cima e veja o que está saindo."

decisions.choice: the seventh vision: wickedness shut in a basket and carried off to Babylon
decisions.reason: Zechariah sees a measuring basket with a woman inside it. The angel calls her Wickedness, shuts her in, and two winged women carry the basket away to Shinar, where a house is built for it (verses 6-11). The flying scroll purged wrongdoers from the land; this vision removes wickedness itself, and sends it back to the land of the exile.

decisions.choice: going out: the same verb used for the angel, the curse and the basket
decisions.reason: The angel goes out, and the thing he points to is "going out", as the curse was in verse 3. The repeated verb ties the visions together: what is evil leaves the land.

decisions.choice: stepped forward (B); came forward (R); Look up (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "stepped forward" and "came forward", since the angel steps into view, and "Look up" for "lift up your eyes", as in 2:1. "Please" is left to the tone, as in 1:4.

decisions.choice: "l'ange qui parlait avec moi" at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet; the imperfect keeps the angel's ongoing role through the visions.

decisions.choice: "el ángel que hablaba conmigo"
decisions.reason: The angel of the night visions is named the same way at every level, with the words of Revelation 21:15 in Spanish.

decisions.choice: "나와 말하던 천사" at every level
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for Zechariah's guide [Rev 21:15 L]; as recorded at 1:9 for the whole book. The angel takes no -시-.

decisions.choice: "thiên sứ đang nói với tôi" for "the angel who talked with me", at every level
alternatives: "thiên sứ nói chuyện với tôi"; "thiên sứ đã nói với tôi"
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps one wording for this title of the angel through Zechariah 1–6.

source.text: וָאֹמַ֖ר מַה־הִ֑יא וַיֹּ֗אמֶר זֹ֤את הָֽאֵיפָה֙ הַיּוֹצֵ֔את וַיֹּ֕אמֶר זֹ֥את עֵינָ֖ם בְּכָל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I said, What [is] it? And he said, This [is] the ephah going out. And he said, This [is] their eye in all the land.

en.L: Then I said, "What [is] it?" He said, "This [is] the ephah going out." And he said, "This [is] their eye in all the land."
en.B: I asked, "What is it?" He said, "This is an ephah basket coming out." He added, "This is what they are like throughout the land."
en.R: I asked, "What is it?" He said, "It is a large basket for measuring grain, and it is coming out." He also said, "This shows what the people all over the land are like."

fr.L: Et je dis : « Qu’[est]-ce ? » Et il dit : « Ceci [est] l’épha qui sort. » Et il dit : « Ceci [est] leur œil dans tout le pays. »
fr.B: Je demandai : « Qu’est-ce que c’est ? » Il répondit : « C’est un boisseau, un épha, qui sort. » Et il ajouta : « Voilà à quoi ils ressemblent dans tout le pays. »
fr.R: J’ai demandé : « Qu’est-ce que c’est ? » Il a répondu : « C’est un grand panier qui sert à mesurer le grain, et il sort. » Il a ajouté : « Il montre comment sont les gens dans tout le pays. »

es.L: Y dije: «¿Qué [es] ello?». Y él dijo: «Esta [es] el efa que sale». Y dijo: «Este [es] su ojo en toda la tierra».
es.B: Le pregunté: «¿Qué es?». Me dijo: «Es una canasta de un efa que sale». Y añadió: «Así es como son ellos en toda la tierra».
es.R: Le pregunté: «¿Qué es?». Me dijo: «Es una canasta grande para medir grano, y está saliendo». También dijo: «Esto muestra cómo es la gente en todo el país».

vi.L: Tôi nói: "Đó [là] gì?" Người nói: "Đây [là] cái ê-pha đang đi ra." Người lại nói: "Đây [là] mắt của chúng trong khắp xứ."
vi.B: Tôi hỏi: "Đó là gì?" Người đáp: "Đây là một cái thúng ê-pha đang đi ra." Rồi người nói thêm: "Đó là bộ mặt của dân chúng trong khắp xứ."
vi.R: Tôi hỏi: "Đó là gì?" Người đáp: "Đó là một cái thúng lớn dùng để đong lúa, và nó đang đi ra." Người cũng nói: "Cái thúng này cho thấy dân chúng khắp xứ là như thế nào."

sw.L: Nami nikasema, "[Ni] nini hicho?" Akasema, "Hii [ndiyo] efa inayotoka." Akasema tena, "Hili [ndilo] jicho lao katika nchi yote."
sw.B: Nikauliza, "Ni nini hicho?" Akasema, "Hiki ni kikapu cha kupimia efa kinachotoka." Akaongeza, "Hivi ndivyo watu walivyo katika nchi yote."
sw.R: Nikauliza, "Ni nini hicho?" Akasema, "Ni kikapu kikubwa cha kupimia nafaka, nacho kinatoka." Akasema pia, "Kikapu hiki kinaonyesha jinsi watu wa nchi yote walivyo."

ko.L: 내가 말했다. "그것이 무엇입니까?" 그가 말했다. "이것은 나가는 에바이다." 그리고 그가 말했다. "이것은 온 땅에 있는 그들의 눈이다."
ko.B: 내가 물었다. "저것이 무엇입니까?" 그가 말했다. "이것은 나오고 있는 에바 바구니이다." 그가 또 말했다. "이것이 온 땅에 있는 그들의 모습이다."
ko.R: 내가 물었다. "저것이 무엇입니까?" 그가 말했다. "곡식을 되는 큰 바구니인데, 지금 나오고 있다." 그가 또 말했다. "이것은 온 땅의 사람들이 어떠한지를 보여 준다."

pt.L: Então eu disse: "Que [é] isso?" Ele disse: "Este [é] o efa que está saindo." E disse: "Este [é] o olho deles em toda a terra."
pt.B: Perguntei: "O que é isso?" Ele disse: "É um cesto de efa que está saindo." E acrescentou: "Assim é o povo em toda a terra."
pt.R: Perguntei: "O que é isso?" Ele disse: "É um cesto grande de medir cereais, e ele está saindo." Ele disse também: "Isso mostra como são as pessoas em toda a terra."

decisions.choice: the ephah: a basket or container that held an ephah of grain
decisions.reason: An ephah was a measure for grain and flour, about 20 quarts by the reckoning used in the published books. Here the word means the container that held that amount, large enough for a woman to sit in (verse 7). Since a measure is used in trade, some see in it a hint of the cheating in business the prophets condemned (Amos 8:5; Micah 6:10-11).

decisions.choice: their eye: what they look like, their appearance
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "their eye", which can mean their look or appearance (Leviticus 13:55; Numbers 11:7), that is, what the people of the land are like. The Greek and Syriac translations read "their iniquity", a word that differs by one letter, which is very similar in shape in Hebrew writing. That reading makes the angel's meaning plainer, and many follow it. The translation keeps the Hebrew, whose sense is close: the basket shows the evil found throughout the land. This description of the ancient translations is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: the ephah (L); an ephah basket (B); a large basket for measuring grain (R); their eye (L); what they are like (B, R)
decisions.reason: The ephah is a container here, not an amount, so it takes no units setting. Literal keeps the Hebrew words; Balanced and Readable say what is meant. The basket keeps its image at every level.

decisions.choice: "l'épha" (L), "un boisseau, un épha" (B), "un grand panier qui sert à mesurer le grain" (R)
decisions.reason: French "boisseau" is the old container for measuring grain and matches the term sheet's "la femme dans le boisseau"; Balanced adds the Hebrew measure's name, Readable says what it is.

decisions.choice: "Voilà à quoi ils ressemblent" (B), "Il montre comment sont les gens" (R) for "their eye"
decisions.reason: As the English, following the meaning decision; the reading "their iniquity" is in its footnote.

decisions.choice: "el efa" (L); "una canasta de un efa" (B); "una canasta grande para medir grano" (R); "su ojo" (L); "así es como son" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The ephah is the measure "efa", as in Amos 8:5; B and R say it is a basket, and the vision then calls it "la canasta". "Their eye" is kept at L; B and R give its sense, as the meaning decision reads it.

decisions.choice: "efa" (L); "kikapu cha kupimia efa" (B); "kikapu kikubwa cha kupimia nafaka" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the measure's name, as the English does; Balanced and Readable name the container, a basket that held an ephah of grain. Later verses say "kikapu" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "에바" (L); "에바 바구니" (B); "곡식을 되는 큰 바구니" (R)
decisions.reason: The ephah is a measure; the vision means the basket that held it (meaning decision). Korean names the measure at L and adds what it is at B and R, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "cái ê-pha" (L) / "cái thúng ê-pha" (B) / "cái thúng lớn dùng để đong lúa" (R); "mắt của chúng" (L) / "bộ mặt của dân chúng" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Thúng" is the everyday Vietnamese basket for measuring grain. "Bộ mặt" says what they look like, the sense of "their eye"; its ring of "true face" fits the vision.

decisions.choice: o efa (L); um cesto de efa (B); um cesto grande de medir cereais (R); o olho deles (L); Assim é o povo (B); como são as pessoas (R)
decisions.reason: The ephah here is the container (m1), so it takes no units setting. Literal keeps "o efa", the form Ezekiel 45:10 has in Portuguese; Balanced says "cesto de efa" and Readable says what it was, as the English does (r-en-1). "Their eye" (m2) is kept at Literal and explained at Balanced and Readable.

source.text: וְהִנֵּ֛ה כִּכַּ֥ר עֹפֶ֖רֶת נִשֵּׂ֑את וְזֹאת֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה אַחַ֔ת יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּת֥וֹךְ הָאֵיפָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And look, a round cover of lead was lifted up, and this [was] a woman, one, sitting in [the] midst of the ephah.

en.L: And look, a round lid of lead was lifted up, and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah!
en.B: Then the lead cover was lifted, and there was a woman sitting inside the basket.
en.R: Then the lead cover of the basket was lifted, and I saw a woman sitting inside it.

fr.L: Et voici, un disque de plomb fut soulevé, et voici une femme assise au milieu de l’épha.
fr.B: Alors le couvercle de plomb fut soulevé, et il y avait une femme assise dans le boisseau.
fr.R: Ensuite, le couvercle de plomb du panier a été soulevé, et j’ai vu une femme assise dedans.

es.L: Y he aquí, una tapa redonda de plomo fue levantada, y había una mujer sentada en medio del efa.
es.B: Entonces levantaron la tapa de plomo, y había una mujer sentada dentro de la canasta.
es.R: Entonces levantaron la tapa de plomo de la canasta, y vi a una mujer sentada adentro.

vi.L: Và kìa, một nắp tròn bằng chì được nhấc lên, và đây là một người đàn bà đang ngồi giữa cái ê-pha!
vi.B: Rồi cái nắp bằng chì được nhấc lên, và có một người đàn bà ngồi trong thúng.
vi.R: Rồi cái nắp chì của thúng được nhấc lên, và tôi thấy một người đàn bà ngồi bên trong.

sw.L: Na tazama, kifuniko cha mviringo cha risasi kikainuliwa, na huyu [alikuwa] mwanamke mmoja ameketi katikati ya efa!
sw.B: Kisha kifuniko cha risasi kikainuliwa, na mle ndani ya kikapu alikuwa ameketi mwanamke.
sw.R: Kisha kifuniko cha risasi cha kikapu kikainuliwa, nami nikaona mwanamke ameketi ndani yake.

ko.L: 보라, 납으로 된 둥근 뚜껑이 들어 올려졌는데, 에바 한가운데 한 여자가 앉아 있었다!
ko.B: 그때 납 뚜껑이 들리자, 바구니 안에 한 여자가 앉아 있었다.
ko.R: 그때 바구니의 무거운 납 뚜껑이 열렸다. 그러자 그 안에 한 여자가 앉아 있는 것이 보였다.

pt.L: E eis que uma tampa redonda de chumbo foi levantada, e ali [estava] uma mulher sentada no meio do efa!
pt.B: Então a tampa de chumbo foi levantada, e havia uma mulher sentada dentro do cesto.
pt.R: Então a tampa de chumbo do cesto foi levantada, e eu vi uma mulher sentada dentro dele.

decisions.choice: a round lid of lead: a heavy disk of lead used as a cover
decisions.reason: The word means something round: a round loaf, a round district, or a disk of metal used as a weight, the talent (Exodus 25:39). Here it is a lead disk covering the basket. Lead is heavy, and the cover is meant to keep in what is inside.

decisions.choice: a woman: one woman, a figure in the vision
decisions.reason: "One woman" here means simply "a woman". Verse 8 says who she stands for.

decisions.choice: Then (B, R); look (L)
decisions.reason: As in 2:7, Balanced and Readable show "look" with "then" and say what Zechariah saw.

decisions.choice: "dans le panier" (R) for the ephah
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "boisseau" at L and B and "panier" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "la tapa de plomo"
decisions.reason: The round lead disk is a lid at every level; B and R use an impersonal "levantaron" for the passive.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ זֹ֣את הָרִשְׁעָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖הּ אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ הָֽאֵיפָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֛ךְ אֶת־אֶ֥בֶן הָעֹפֶ֖רֶת אֶל־פִּֽיהָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he said, This [is] the wickedness. And he threw her into [the] midst of the ephah, and threw the stone of the lead on its mouth.

en.L: And he said, "This [is] Wickedness." And he cast her into the midst of the ephah, and cast the lead weight upon its mouth.
en.B: He said, "This is Wickedness." Then he pushed her back down into the basket and pressed the lead cover down over its opening.
en.R: The angel said, "This woman is Wickedness." Then he pushed her back down into the basket and slammed the heavy lead cover over the top.

fr.L: Et il dit : « Ceci [est] la Méchanceté. » Et il la jeta au milieu de l’épha, et il jeta la pierre de plomb sur son ouverture.
fr.B: Il dit : « C’est la Méchanceté. » Puis il la repoussa au fond du boisseau et rabattit le couvercle de plomb sur l’ouverture.
fr.R: L’ange a dit : « Cette femme, c’est la Méchanceté. » Puis il l’a repoussée au fond du panier et il a refermé le lourd couvercle de plomb par-dessus.

es.L: Y dijo: «Esta [es] la Maldad». Y la arrojó en medio del efa, y arrojó la pesa de plomo sobre su boca.
es.B: Me dijo: «Esta es la Maldad». Entonces la empujó otra vez dentro de la canasta y apretó la tapa de plomo sobre la abertura.
es.R: El ángel dijo: «Esta mujer es la Maldad». Luego la empujó otra vez dentro de la canasta y la cerró de golpe con la pesada tapa de plomo.

vi.L: Người nói: "Đây [là] Sự Gian Ác." Rồi người ném người đàn bà ấy vào giữa cái ê-pha, và ném khối chì lên miệng nó.
vi.B: Người nói: "Đây là Sự Gian Ác." Rồi người đẩy người đàn bà xuống lại trong thúng và đè nắp chì lên miệng thúng.
vi.R: Thiên sứ nói: "Người đàn bà này là Sự Gian Ác." Rồi người đẩy bà ta trở xuống trong thúng và đóng mạnh nắp chì nặng lên trên.

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Huyu [ndiye] Uovu." Akamtupa katikati ya efa, akalitupa lile jiwe la risasi juu ya kinywa chake.
sw.B: Akasema, "Huyu ni Uovu." Kisha akamsukuma tena chini ndani ya kikapu, akakibana kifuniko cha risasi juu ya mdomo wake.
sw.R: Malaika akasema, "Mwanamke huyu ni Uovu." Kisha akamsukuma tena chini ndani ya kikapu, akakifunika kwa nguvu kwa kifuniko kizito cha risasi.

ko.L: 그가 말했다. "이것은 '악'이다." 그리고 그가 그 여자를 에바 한가운데로 던져 넣고, 납 덩이를 그 아가리 위에 던져 덮었다.
ko.B: 그가 말했다. "이것은 '악'이다." 그러고는 그 여자를 바구니 속으로 도로 밀어 넣고, 납 뚜껑으로 그 입구를 눌러 덮었다.
ko.R: 천사가 말했다. "이 여자는 '악'이다." 그러고는 그 여자를 바구니 속으로 다시 밀어 넣고, 무거운 납 뚜껑으로 위를 꽉 덮어 버렸다.

pt.L: E ele disse: "Esta [é] a Maldade." E a lançou no meio do efa e lançou o peso de chumbo sobre a sua boca.
pt.B: Ele disse: "Esta é a Maldade." Então a empurrou de volta para dentro do cesto e apertou a tampa de chumbo sobre a abertura.
pt.R: O anjo disse: "Esta mulher é a Maldade." Então ele a empurrou de volta para dentro do cesto e fechou com força a pesada tampa de chumbo.

decisions.choice: Wickedness: all the wrongdoing of the land, pictured as a woman
decisions.reason: The word means wickedness or guilt. In Hebrew it is a feminine noun, so in the vision it takes the form of a woman, as wisdom and folly are pictured as women in Proverbs (Proverbs 9:1-6, 13-18). The figure stands for the sin of the whole land, not for women. The angel names her, shuts her in, and in the verses that follow she is carried away.

decisions.choice: thrown back and shut in: wickedness is held fast so that it cannot escape
decisions.reason: The woman seems to rise when the lid is lifted, and the angel forces her back and seals the basket with the heavy lead. Wickedness is no longer free in the land; it is under God's control and about to be removed.

decisions.choice: Wickedness, capitalized, at every level
decisions.reason: The angel uses the word as a name for the woman in the vision, so it is capitalized. Readable says "This woman is", and "the heavy lead cover" for "the weight of lead", to keep the picture clear.

decisions.choice: "la Méchanceté", capitalised, at every level
decisions.reason: A feminine noun, so the woman of the vision can be named by it as in Hebrew; capitalised as the English, since it is the woman's name in the vision.

decisions.choice: "la Maldad", capitalized
decisions.reason: As in the English, the woman is wickedness personified, so the word is capitalized at every level.

decisions.choice: "Uovu", capitalized, at every level, with personal agreement ("Huyu ni Uovu", "akamtupa")
decisions.reason: The English capitalizes Wickedness as a figure; Swahili gives the woman the name and lets the verbs treat her as a person.

decisions.choice: '악' in inner quotation marks at every level
decisions.reason: The English capitalizes Wickedness as a figure; Korean has no capitals, so the name is set off with single quotation marks inside the speech.

decisions.choice: "Sự Gian Ác", capitalised, at every level
decisions.reason: Capitals mark the woman as wickedness personified, as the English capital does; "gian ác" is the usual Vietnamese Bible word for wickedness.

decisions.choice: a Maldade, with a capital, at every level
decisions.reason: The word is used as a name for the woman (m1), so it has a capital, as the English does (r-en-1). "Maldade" is a feminine noun in Portuguese too, so the woman of the vision fits the word as she does in Hebrew; "iniquidade" is kept for 'awon (3:4, 9).

source.text: וָאֶשָּׂ֨א עֵינַ֜י וָאֵ֗רֶא וְהִנֵּה֩ שְׁתַּ֨יִם נָשִׁ֤ים יֽוֹצְאוֹת֙ וְר֣וּחַ בְּכַנְפֵיהֶ֔ם וְלָהֵ֥נָּה כְנָפַ֖יִם כְּכַנְפֵ֣י הַחֲסִידָ֑ה וַתִּשֶּׂ֨אנָה֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֵיפָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבֵ֥ין הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I lifted up my eyes and saw, and look, two women going out, and wind in their wings, and they had wings like [the] wings of the stork; and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heavens.

en.L: And I lifted up my eyes and saw, and look, two women coming out, with wind in their wings; and they had wings like the wings of the stork, and they lifted the ephah between the earth and the heavens.
en.B: Then I looked up, and there were two women coming out, with the wind in their wings. They had wings like a stork's wings, and they lifted the basket up between earth and sky.
en.R: Then I looked up and saw two women flying out with the wind in their wings. Their wings were like the wings of a stork. They lifted the basket up into the air, between the earth and the sky.

fr.L: Et je levai les yeux et je regardai, et voici, deux femmes sortaient, et le vent [était] dans leurs ailes ; et elles avaient des ailes comme les ailes de la cigogne, et elles soulevèrent l’épha entre la terre et les cieux.
fr.B: Puis je levai les yeux, et je vis deux femmes qui sortaient, le vent dans leurs ailes. Elles avaient des ailes semblables à celles de la cigogne, et elles soulevèrent le boisseau entre la terre et le ciel.
fr.R: Ensuite, j’ai levé les yeux et j’ai vu deux femmes qui sortaient en volant, portées par le vent. Elles avaient des ailes comme celles d’une cigogne. Elles ont soulevé le panier dans les airs, entre la terre et le ciel.

es.L: Y alcé mis ojos y miré, y he aquí, dos mujeres que salían, con viento en sus alas; y tenían alas como alas de cigüeña, y alzaron el efa entre la tierra y los cielos.
es.B: Luego levanté la vista y vi a dos mujeres que salían, con el viento en sus alas. Tenían alas como de cigüeña, y levantaron la canasta entre la tierra y el cielo.
es.R: Luego levanté la vista y vi a dos mujeres que salían volando con el viento en sus alas. Sus alas eran como las de una cigüeña. Levantaron la canasta por el aire, entre la tierra y el cielo.

vi.L: Tôi ngước mắt lên và thấy, kìa, hai người đàn bà đi ra, có gió trong cánh của họ; họ có cánh như cánh con cò, và họ nhấc cái ê-pha lên giữa đất và trời.
vi.B: Rồi tôi ngước mắt nhìn lên, và kìa, có hai người đàn bà đi ra, gió lộng trong cánh họ. Họ có cánh giống như cánh cò, và họ nâng cái thúng lên giữa đất và trời.
vi.R: Rồi tôi nhìn lên và thấy hai người đàn bà bay ra, gió thổi trong cánh họ. Cánh của họ giống như cánh con cò. Họ nâng cái thúng bay lên không trung, giữa đất và trời.

sw.L: Nikainua macho yangu nikaona, na tazama, wanawake wawili wakitoka, na upepo [ulikuwa] katika mabawa yao; nao walikuwa na mabawa kama mabawa ya korongo, wakaiinua efa kati ya nchi na mbingu.
sw.B: Kisha nikatazama juu, na tazama, wanawake wawili walikuwa wakitoka, upepo ukiwa katika mabawa yao. Walikuwa na mabawa kama mabawa ya korongo, wakakiinua kikapu juu kati ya nchi na anga.
sw.R: Kisha nikatazama juu, nikaona wanawake wawili wakiruka nje, upepo ukiwa katika mabawa yao. Mabawa yao yalikuwa kama mabawa ya korongo. Wakakiinua kikapu juu angani, kati ya nchi na anga.

ko.L: 내가 눈을 들어 보니, 보라, 두 여자가 나오는데, 그들의 날개에 바람이 있었다. 그들에게는 황새의 날개 같은 날개가 있었고, 그들이 에바를 땅과 하늘 사이로 들어 올렸다.
ko.B: 내가 눈을 들어 보니, 두 여자가 나오고 있었는데, 날개에 바람을 안고 있었다. 그들에게는 황새 날개 같은 날개가 있었고, 그들이 그 바구니를 땅과 하늘 사이로 들어 올렸다.
ko.R: 내가 고개를 들어 보니, 두 여자가 날개에 바람을 받으며 날아 나오고 있었다. 그들의 날개는 황새의 날개 같았다. 그들은 바구니를 공중으로, 땅과 하늘 사이로 들어 올렸다.

pt.L: E levantei os meus olhos e vi, e eis que duas mulheres saindo, com vento nas suas asas; e elas tinham asas como as asas da cegonha, e levantaram o efa entre a terra e os céus.
pt.B: Então olhei para cima, e havia duas mulheres saindo, com o vento nas suas asas. Elas tinham asas como as de uma cegonha, e levantaram o cesto entre a terra e o céu.
pt.R: Então olhei para cima e vi duas mulheres saindo voando, com o vento nas asas. As asas delas eram como as asas de uma cegonha. Elas levantaram o cesto no ar, entre a terra e o céu.

decisions.choice: the stork: a large bird with broad, strong wings
decisions.reason: The stork is a large bird that migrates over the land of Israel in spring and autumn, flying great distances (Jeremiah 8:7). Its wide wings suit the carrying of a heavy load far away. The law counts it among the unclean birds (Leviticus 11:19), which some see as fitting for those who carry wickedness.

decisions.choice: wind in their wings: the wind carries them
decisions.reason: The word means wind, breath or spirit. Here it is the wind that fills their wings and carries them, so that the basket is lifted and borne away.

decisions.choice: two women: bearers in the vision, not explained
decisions.reason: The angel does not say who the women are. They are simply the means by which the basket is carried away. Like the woman in the basket, they are part of the picture.

decisions.choice: I looked up (B, R); between earth and sky (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "looked up", as in 2:1, and "sky" for "heavens", which here means the air above the earth.

decisions.choice: "cigüeña"
decisions.reason: The bird is "cigüeña", as in Deuteronomy 14:18 and Jeremiah 8:7 in Spanish.

decisions.choice: "korongo" for the stork
decisions.reason: "Korongo" is the common Swahili name for the stork, a large bird with broad wings, which is the point of the comparison.

source.text: וָאֹמַ֕ר אֶל־הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י אָ֛נָה הֵ֥מָּה מֽוֹלִכ֖וֹת אֶת־הָאֵיפָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I said to the angel who talks with me, Where [are] they taking the ephah?

en.L: And I said to the angel who talked with me, "Where are they taking the ephah?"
en.B: I asked the angel who talked with me, "Where are they taking the basket?"
en.R: I asked the angel who talked with me, "Where are they taking the basket?"

fr.L: Et je dis à l’ange qui parlait avec moi : « Où emportent-elles l’épha ? »
fr.B: Je demandai à l’ange qui parlait avec moi : « Où emportent-elles le boisseau ? »
fr.R: J’ai demandé à l’ange qui parlait avec moi : « Où est-ce qu’elles emportent le panier ? »

es.L: Y dije al ángel que hablaba conmigo: «¿Adónde llevan ellas el efa?».
es.B: Le pregunté al ángel que hablaba conmigo: «¿Adónde llevan la canasta?».
es.R: Le pregunté al ángel que hablaba conmigo: «¿Adónde llevan la canasta?».

vi.L: Tôi nói với thiên sứ đang nói với tôi: "Họ đem cái ê-pha đi đâu vậy?"

records.literal_gloss: And he said to me, To build for it a house in [the] land of Shinar; and it will be prepared, and it will be set there on its base.

en.L: And he said to me, "To build a house for it in the land of Shinar; and when it is prepared, it will be set down there on its own base."
en.B: He answered, "To the land of Shinar, to build a house for it. When the house is ready, the basket will be set down there on its base."
en.R: He answered, "To Babylonia. A temple will be built for it there. When the temple is ready, the basket will be set there on its stand."

fr.L: Et il me dit : « Pour lui bâtir une maison dans le pays de Shinéar ; et quand elle sera prête, il y sera déposé sur sa base. »
fr.B: Il me répondit : « Au pays de Shinéar, pour lui bâtir une maison. Quand la maison sera prête, on y déposera le boisseau sur son socle. »
fr.R: Il m’a répondu : « En Babylonie. On va lui construire un temple là-bas. Quand le temple sera prêt, on y installera le panier sur son support. »

es.L: Y me dijo: «Para edificarle una casa en la tierra de Sinar; y cuando esté preparada, será asentada allí sobre su base».

es.R: Me respondió: «A Babilonia. Allí le van a construir un templo. Cuando el templo esté listo, pondrán allí la canasta sobre su pedestal».

vi.L: Người nói với tôi: "Để xây cho nó một cái nhà trong xứ Si-nê-a; và khi [nhà] được chuẩn bị xong, nó sẽ được đặt tại đó trên bệ của nó."

decisions.choice: the land of Shinar: Babylonia
decisions.reason: Shinar is the old name of the land of Babylon (Genesis 10:10; 11:2, where the tower of Babel was built; Daniel 1:2). It is the place of human pride against God and the place of Judah's exile. Wickedness is sent back to the land it came from, and the land of Judah is left clean.

decisions.choice: a house ... on its base: a shrine where the basket will stand like an idol
decisions.reason: "House" is the word for a temple as well as a home, and the base is a stand or pedestal (the same word is used for the stands of Solomon's temple, 1 Kings 7:27). Wickedness will be set up in Babylon like an idol in its shrine, while in Jerusalem the LORD's house is being built.

decisions.choice: Babylonia (R); a temple (R); stand (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "Babylonia" for Shinar and "temple" for "house", which is what the house is (m2). Balanced and Readable name "the house" and "the basket" where the Hebrew says "it".
